rules.title: E0001: Opening tag position
rules.bad_example:
<?php
// There is an empty blank line before the opening tag!
echo "Hello World";
rules.good_example:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

echo "Hello World";
what_it_checks: Ensures `<?php` or `<?=` is on line 1 of the file.
Ensures the opening tag starts at column 1 (no leading indentation/spaces).
Automatically allows Unix shebang (`#!...`) lines in CLI scripts on line 1.

rules.title: E0100: Variable function call
what_it_checks: `$func()` where `$func` is assigned from tainted superglobals

rules.title: E0101: Object injection via unserialize
what_it_checks: `unserialize()` calls where the argument may originate from `$_GET`, `$_POST`, `$_REQUEST`, `$_COOKIE`, `php://input`

rules.title: E0102: Command injection via proc_open
what_it_checks: `proc_open()` calls where the command string contains tainted input

rules.title: E0103: Server-side request forgery
what_it_checks: HTTP client libraries (Guzzle, Symfony HttpClient) with user-controlled URLs

rules.title: E0104: HTTP response splitting
what_it_checks: `header()` calls with tainted input that may contain CRLF sequences
`setcookie()` with tainted values that may contain newlines

rules.title: E0105: Local file inclusion
what_it_checks: `include`, `require`, `include_once`, `require_once` with paths built from tainted input
`../` or null byte (`%00`) sequences in user-controlled paths

rules.title: E0106: Deserialization of untrusted data
what_it_checks: `unserialize()` calls with tainted input from superglobals

rules.title: E0107: Weak random for security tokens
rules.good_example:
$token = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));   // cryptographically secure
$resetToken = random_int(100000, 999999); // cryptographically secure
what_it_checks: `rand()`, `mt_rand()`, `uniqid()` used for security-sensitive purposes (tokens, keys, salts)

rules.title: E0108: Dynamic instantiation
what_it_checks: `new $class()` where `$class` comes from superglobal array access
`class_exists()` followed by instantiation of user-controlled class names

rules.title: E0109: Directory listing exposure
what_it_checks: Directory traversal patterns (`../`) in directory arguments

rules.title: E0011: Detect the error suppression symbol: @
what_it_checks: Scans expressions and return statements for the error control unary prefix operator (`@`).

rules.title: E0110: Raw SQL query execution
what_it_checks: `PDO::query()`, `mysqli_query()`, `pg_query()` with SQL strings containing interpolated variables
SQL queries built by string concatenation with user input

rules.title: E0111: Deprecated mysql extension
what_it_checks: Any function with the `mysql_` prefix (except `mysqlnd` which is a driver, not the extension)

rules.title: E0112: File upload without validation
E0113: Session regeneration missing
what_it_checks: `session_start()` followed by `$_SESSION` writes without a subsequent `session_regenerate_id()`
Login/auth endpoints that set session data without regenerating the ID

rules.title: E0114: PHP info disclosure
rules.good_example:
// Remove phpinfo() entirely from production code
// Use it only in local development, never commit it
what_it_checks: `phpinfo()` function calls anywhere in committed source code

rules.title: E0115: XXE via libxml
what_it_checks: `simplexml_load_string()`, `DOMDocument::loadXML()`, `DOMDocument::load()` with tainted input and `LIBXML_NOENT` or without `LIBXML_NONET`

rules.title: E0116: Remote command execution via popen
what_it_checks: `popen()` calls where the command string contains tainted input from superglobals
`popen()` with user-controlled command arguments without `escapeshellcmd()` or `escapeshellarg()`

rules.title: E0117: SQL injection via query string
what_it_checks: SQL queries built by string concatenation with query string input

rules.title: E0118: Log forging via user input
rules.bad_example:
error_log("User {$_GET['username']} logged in");
// ?username=admin%0d%0aInjection: fake admin login
rules.good_example:
$username = str_replace(["\r", "\n"], '', $_GET['username'] ?? '');
error_log("User $username logged in");
what_it_checks: Custom log writers (`file_put_contents($log, $user_input)`) with user input

rules.title: E0119: Session cookie without Secure flag
what_it_checks: `ini_set('session.cookie_secure', '0')` or not setting it at all
Session cookies created without the Secure attribute

rules.title: E0012: Service compatibility with Shared Memory Model
what_it_checks: Detects assignments to `$this->property` or static properties (`self::$prop`) inside methods (excluding constructors).
Allows classes that implement a reset interface (e.g., `ResetInterface`) designed to clear state between requests.

rules.title: E0120: Eval with user-controlled string
what_it_checks: `eval()` calls where the string argument contains tainted input
String concatenation inside `eval()` with user-controlled variables

rules.title: E0121: Assert with user-controlled string
what_it_checks: `assert()` calls where the argument is a string containing tainted input
String concatenation inside `assert()` with user-controlled variables

rules.title: E0122: File inclusion with user input
what_it_checks: `$_GET`, `$_POST`, `$_REQUEST`, `$_COOKIE` values used directly in include paths

rules.title: E0123: XSS via echo
rules.good_example:
$name = $_GET['name'] ?? '';
echo "Hello, " . htmlspecialchars($name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
what_it_checks: `<?=$var ?>` short echo tags with unescaped variables

rules.title: E0124: Weak hash for passwords
rules.bad_example:
$hash = md5($password);       // weak, fast, unsalted
$hash = sha1($password);      // weak, fast, unsalted
$hash = crypt($password);     // weak, may use DES-based crypt

rules.title: E0125: Open redirect via header
E0126: Path traversal via file_get_contents
what_it_checks: `file_get_contents()`, `file()`, `readfile()`, `fopen()` with paths built from tainted input
`../` or null byte (`%00`) sequences in user-controlled paths

rules.title: E0127: Command execution via system
what_it_checks: Backtick operator (`` `$cmd` ``) with tainted input (also covered by E0087)

rules.title: E0128: Command execution via exec
what_it_checks: `exec()` calls where the command string contains tainted input
`exec()` with user-controlled command arguments without escaping

rules.title: E0129: Command execution via shell_exec
what_it_checks: `shell_exec()` calls where the command string contains tainted input
`shell_exec()` with user-controlled command arguments without escaping

rules.title: E0013: Private method not being called.
what_it_checks: Scans all classes for methods marked `private`.
Inspects all method calls (`$this->methodName()`) within the class.
Reports any private method that is never referenced in any method body.

rules.title: E0130: Command execution via passthru
what_it_checks: `passthru()` calls where the command string contains tainted input
`passthru()` with user-controlled command arguments without escaping

rules.title: E0131: Command execution via proc_open
what_it_checks: `proc_open()` calls where the command string contains tainted input
`proc_open()` with user-controlled command arguments without `escapeshellarg()` or `escapeshellcmd()`

rules.title: E0132: Header injection via header
what_it_checks: `header()` calls with tainted input that may contain CRLF sequences
`header()` calls where user input is interpolated into the header value

rules.title: E0133: Header injection via setcookie
what_it_checks: `setcookie()` or `setrawcookie()` calls where the cookie name or value contains tainted input
Cookie names or values that may contain CRLF sequences

rules.title: E0134: Mail injection via mail
what_it_checks: `mail()` calls where user input is passed to the `$additional_headers` parameter
`mail()` calls where user input is passed to the `$subject` parameter
CRLF sequences (`\r\n`) in mail headers or subject

rules.title: E0135: PHP info disclosure
rules.good_example:
// Remove phpinfo() entirely from production code
// Use it only in local development, never commit it
what_it_checks: `phpinfo()` function calls anywhere in committed source code

rules.title: E0014: Law of Demeter violation. Method chaining should be avoided unless returning the same object type.
E0015: Lack of Cohesion of Methods (LCOM4)
E0002: Empty catch
what_it_checks: Scans `try...catch` blocks where the catch body contains no statements.

rules.title: E0023: Instability (I), Abstractness (A), Distance from Main Sequence (D)
E0024: Lines of Code (LOC) per Method
E0025: Lines of Code (LOC) per File
E0003: Method modifiers
what_it_checks: Scans class methods for missing visibility modifiers (`public`, `protected`, `private`).

rules.title: E0036: Array Index Out of Bounds
E0037: String Offset Out of Bounds
E0004: Uppercase constants
what_it_checks: Constants defined inside classes, interfaces, traits, and enums (`const FOO = ...`).
Verifies that constant names match their uppercase equivalent (`name == name.to_uppercase()`).

rules.title: E0043: Stream Resource Used After Close
E0005: Capitalized class name
what_it_checks: Inspects the declaration of every PHP class.
Verifies that the first letter of the class name is uppercase (`is_uppercase()`).

rules.title: E0050: Position check used as boolean
what_it_checks: Checks used as a ternary condition

rules.title: E0051: Count of a non-countable value
rules.bad_example:
count('hello'); // TypeError
sizeof(42);     // TypeError
count(null);    // TypeError
rules.good_example:
count($items);      // $items is an array
sizeof($collection); // $collection implements Countable
strlen($text);      // use strlen() for strings
what_it_checks: `count()` or `sizeof()` with an integer or float literal
`count()` or `sizeof()` with a boolean or `null` literal

rules.title: E0052: Unchecked json_decode result
rules.good_example:
$data = json_decode($json, true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

return $data['name'];

rules.title: E0053: Unserialize without allowed_classes
what_it_checks: A literal options array without an `allowed_classes` key
`allowed_classes => true`, which explicitly allows every class

rules.title: E0054: Dynamic variable creation
E0055: Dynamic include or require
what_it_checks: A path that is a variable, property access, array access, or function call
A concatenation where any part is dynamic
A conditional or other computed path expression

rules.title: E0056: Weak randomness for security-sensitive value
what_it_checks: Assignments to variables whose names look security-sensitive, such as

rules.title: E0057: MD5 or SHA1 used for a password
what_it_checks: Password-like variables or properties used as the hashed value

rules.title: E0058: Cookie missing Secure or HttpOnly
what_it_checks: `setcookie()` and `setrawcookie()` with missing or disabled `secure` and
Array options, positional arguments, and named arguments
Array keys are matched case-insensitively, so both `httponly` and `httpOnly`

rules.title: E0059: Dynamic eval or assert
what_it_checks: `assert()` with a string literal or string concatenation

rules.title: E0006: Property modifiers
what_it_checks: Scans class properties for missing visibility modifiers.

rules.title: E0060: SQL injection
what_it_checks: Where user input (`$_GET`, `$_POST`, `$_REQUEST`, `$_COOKIE`, etc.) is concatenated directly into the SQL string

rules.title: E0061: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
rules.good_example: echo "Welcome, " . htmlspecialchars($_GET['name'] ?? '', ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
what_it_checks: `echo`, `print`, `printf()`, `vprintf()` calls that output user input directly
String concatenation involving superglobals (`$_GET`, `$_POST`, etc.) in output

rules.title: E0062: Command injection
what_it_checks: Where user input is passed directly or concatenated into the command string

rules.title: E0063: LDAP injection
what_it_checks: `ldap_search()`, `ldap_list()`, `ldap_read()` calls where the filter contains user input without `ldap_escape()`

rules.title: E0064: XPath injection
what_it_checks: `DOMXPath::query()`, `DOMXPath::evaluate()`, `SimpleXMLElement::xpath()` with tainted string concatenation in the XPath expression

rules.title: E0065: NoSQL injection
rules.good_example:
$username = (string)($_GET['user'] ?? '');
$collection->findOne(['username' => $username]);
what_it_checks: MongoDB/PHPLIB `find()`, `findOne()`, `aggregate()` calls with tainted superglobals passed directly as query filters
`$where` clauses with string interpolation of user input

rules.title: E0066: Header injection
E0067: Mail injection
what_it_checks: `mail()` with `$additional_headers` or `$subject` built from tainted input

rules.title: E0068: Eval injection
what_it_checks: `assert()` with a string argument containing user input

rules.title: E0069: Unsafe deserialization
what_it_checks: `unserialize()` calls with tainted input from `$_GET`, `$_POST`, `$_REQUEST`, `$_COOKIE`, or `php://input`

rules.title: E0070: Remote file inclusion
what_it_checks: `include`, `require`, `include_once`, `require_once` where the path is built from user-controlled input
`file_get_contents()`, `readfile()`, `fopen()` with user-controlled file paths from remote sources

rules.title: E0071: Unsafe file upload
what_it_checks: `$_FILES['name']` used directly in file paths without sanitization

rules.title: E0072: Path traversal
what_it_checks: `include`, `require`, `file_get_contents()`, `file_put_contents()`, `fopen()` with paths built from tainted input
`../` or null byte (`%00`) sequences in user-controlled paths

rules.title: E0073: Weak cryptographic hash
rules.bad_example:
$hash = md5($password);   // weak and fast
$hash = sha1($password);  // weak and fast
what_it_checks: `crypt()` without a proper salt or cost parameter

rules.title: E0074: Weak random number generator
rules.good_example:
$token = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));  // cryptographically secure
$key = random_int(1000, 9999);       // cryptographically secure
what_it_checks: `rand()`, `mt_rand()`, `uniqid()` used for security-sensitive purposes (tokens, keys, salts)
`mt_rand()` without seeding from a secure source

rules.title: E0075: Session security
what_it_checks: `session_start()` without prior `session_set_cookie_params()` setting `secure => true` and `httponly => true`

rules.title: E0076: Information disclosure
rules.good_example:
// Remove phpinfo() entirely from production code
// Use it only in local development, never commit it
what_it_checks: `phpinfo()` function calls anywhere in committed source code

rules.title: E0077: Display errors enabled
E0078: Variable variables
what_it_checks: `$$var` variable variables where `$var` originates from user input

rules.title: E0079: Dynamic method call
what_it_checks: `$obj->$method()` where `$method` is a variable from user input

rules.title: E0008: Return type signature
what_it_checks: Scans method declarations for missing return type signatures.

rules.title: E0080: Weak cryptographic function
rules.bad_example:
$hash = crypt($password, '$1$saltsalt$'); // MD5-based crypt, weak
$hash = crypt($password);                   // uses system default, may be weak

rules.title: E0081: Deprecated regex function
E0082: Dynamic extension loading
rules.bad_example:
dl('my_extension.so'); // loads extension at runtime
dl('php_mysql.dll');
what_it_checks: `dl()` function calls anywhere in the code

rules.title: E0083: Open redirect
E0084: SQL query string concatenation
what_it_checks: Where user input (`$_GET`, `$_POST`, `$_REQUEST`, `$_COOKIE`, etc.) is concatenated directly into the SQL string

rules.title: E0085: Inline PHP execution short tags
rules.good_example:
<?php echo $userInput; ?>
<?php echo htmlspecialchars($variable, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'); ?>
what_it_checks: `<?= ... ?>` short echo tags in PHP files

rules.title: E0086: Deprecated session function
E0087: Command execution with backticks
what_it_checks: `shell_exec()`, `exec()`, `system()`, `passthru()` with tainted input (also covered by E0127-E0131)

rules.title: E0088: Reflection-based injection
E0089: Log injection
rules.good_example:
$username = str_replace(["\r", "\n"], '', $_GET['username'] ?? '');
error_log("User $username logged in");
what_it_checks: Custom log writers (`file_put_contents($log, $user_input)`) with user input

rules.title: E0090: File write to user-controlled path
what_it_checks: `file_put_contents()`, `file()`, `fopen()` with `'w'`, `'w+'`, `'a'`, `'a+'` modes where the path is built from user-controlled input

rules.title: E0091: Source code exposure via highlight_file
rules.good_example:
// Remove entirely — never expose source code to users
// If debugging is needed, use a local development environment only
what_it_checks: Especially dangerous when gated by user input (`$_GET['debug']`)

rules.title: E0092: XML External Entity (XXE)
what_it_checks: `simplexml_load_string()`, `DOMDocument::loadXML()`, `DOMDocument::load()` with tainted input and `LIBXML_NOENT` or without `LIBXML_NONET`

rules.title: E0093: Template injection
what_it_checks: Template engines rendering user-controlled strings as template source

rules.title: E0094: Denial of service via regular expression
what_it_checks: Nested quantifiers in regex patterns: `(a+)+`, `(a*)*`, `(a|b)+` etc.
`preg_match()` on very long user input without timeout

rules.title: E0095: Insecure comparison
what_it_checks: `==` or `===` comparisons where one operand is a secret-like variable (`token`, `secret`, `key`, `password`, `hash`, `signature`, `mac`, `hmac`)
Both operands must be strings for the timing issue to apply

rules.title: E0096: Cookie without secure flag
what_it_checks: `setcookie()` or `setrawcookie()` calls where `secure` is not set to `true`

rules.title: E0097: Cookie without HttpOnly flag
what_it_checks: `setcookie()` or `setrawcookie()` calls where `httponly` is not set to `true`

rules.title: E0098: Session ID in URL
what_it_checks: Links containing `PHPSESSID` or similar session ID parameters

rules.title: E0099: Disable functions bypass
rules.bad_example:
// php.ini: disable_functions not set (empty)
// All functions remain available
rules.good_example: // php.ini: disable_functions = exec,system,passthru,shell_exec,popen,proc_open,eval,create_function
what_it_checks: Cannot read php.ini directly — documents the risk
`ini_set('disable_functions', ...)` is PHP_INI_SYSTEM and cannot be changed at runtime
